name: glass-button
props: Button text. Leave it out (with an icon) for a circular icon button.
Icon before the label. `useGlassButtonInk({ variant, tint, scheme })` returns the colour to draw it in.
Height 36 / 44 / 52; icon-only buttons are circles of that size. `GLASS_ICON_SIZE[size]` is the matching icon size.
Plain monochrome glass, or glass washed with `tint` — the label switches to black or white to stay readable.
Wash colour for the tinted variant.
Force light or dark glass, e.g. 'dark' over photos.
Press handler; disabled dims the button and blocks presses.
Outer style: margins, position, width or flex (buttons hug their content by default).
{ key, icon, label, onPress?, active?, disabled? }[]
Icon buttons. `icon` is a node or `({ color, size, active }) => node`; `label` is the accessibility label; `active` draws a soft bubble in the accent colour.
A cluster of separate glass circles (melting together on iOS 26) instead of one capsule.
Lay items out horizontally or vertically (map-style controls).
Hairlines between capsule items; space between floating circles.
As on GlassButton; accessibilityLabel names the toolbar.
